title: Exhaustive Americas & Polynesia Genealogies (Maya Popol Vuh, Aztec Five Suns, Inca Viracocha/Cusco, North American, Hawaiian Kumulipo, Māori Whakapapa & Tu'i Tonga)

nodes.name: Tepeu, Gucumatz (Feathered Serpent) & Huracán (Heart of Sky)
nodes.notes: Create Earth from primordial waters, test clay and wood humans (destroyed by a Great Flood of resin and water!), and prepare the dawn for maize humanity.

nodes.name: Xpiyacoc & Xmucane → Hun Hunahpu (+ Xquic) → Hero Twins (Hunahpu & Xbalanque)
nodes.role: Defeaters of Xibalba / Sun & Moon Twins
nodes.notes: Grandmother Xmucane's sons Hun Hunahpu & Vucub Hunahpu are slain in Xibalba; Blood Moon maiden Xquic bears the Hero Twins Hunahpu & Xbalanque, who conquer the Underworld Lords and ascend as Sun and Moon!

nodes.name: Four Maize Ancestors: Balam-Quitzé, Balam-Acab, Mahucutah & Iqui-Balam
nodes.era: Creation of True Humanity (Popol Vuh Part 3)
nodes.role: First Four Maya Progenitors & Their 4 Wives
nodes.notes: Shaped from yellow and white maize by the creators alongside their 4 wives (Caha-Paluna, Chomiha, Tzununiha, Caquixaha); migrate from Tulan Zuyua to found the K'iche' & Kaqchikel Maya nations (and parallel Classic Maya dynasties like K'inich Janaab Pakal of Palenque!).

nodes.name: Ometeotl → Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca, Xipe Totec & Huitzilopochtli
nodes.role: Lord of Duality & Four Creator Brothers
sources: Historia de los Mexicanos por sus Pinturas
nodes.notes: Dual supreme creator Ometecuhtli & Omecihuatl births the four cosmic directions/brothers governing the Five Suns of Mesoamerica.

nodes.name: Tata & Nene (Fourth Sun Flood) → Quetzalcoatl Recreates Fifth Sun Humanity
nodes.role: Aztec Great Flood Survivors & Fifth Sun Creation
nodes.notes: Warned by Tezcatlipoca/Titlacahuan of the Great Flood ending the Fourth Sun (Water Sun), Tata & Nene survive inside a hollowed cypress log! Afterwards Quetzalcoatl journeys to Mictlan to retrieve ancestral bones and sprinkle his own blood to create Fifth Sun humanity!

nodes.name: Aztlán / Chicomoztoc → Acamapichtli → Moctezuma I → Moctezuma II
nodes.role: Seven Caves Migration & Tlatoque of Tenochtitlan
nodes.notes: Guided by Huitzilopochtli from Aztlán & the Seven Caves (Chicomoztoc) to Tenochtitlan (1325 CE); 1st Tlatoani Acamapichtli unites Mexica kingship with the sacred Toltec lineage of Ce Acatl Topiltzin Quetzalcoatl, leading to Itzcoatl, Moctezuma I, Moctezuma II, and Cuauhtémoc!

nodes.name: Viracocha (Uno Pachacuti Flood) → Inti (Sun) & Mama Quilla (Moon)
nodes.role: Creator of Andean Nations from Clay & Flood Deity
sources: Garcilaso de la Vega Comentarios Reales
nodes.notes: Viracocha emerges from Lake Titicaca, wipes away unruly stone giants in the Uno Pachacuti (Great Flood!), and shapes each Andean nation from painted clay at Tiwanaku before walking west across the Pacific Ocean!

nodes.name: Manco Cápac & Mama Ocllo (Four Ayar Brothers → Founders of Cusco)
nodes.role: Children of the Sun / First Sapa Inca
nodes.notes: Sent by Sun God Inti from Lake Titicaca (or Pacariqtambo with the Four Ayar Brothers) with a golden staff that sinks into fertile earth at Cusco, founding the Inca Dynasty!

nodes.name: Sinchi Roca → Pachacuti (Machu Picchu) → Tupac Inca → Huayna Capac → Atahualpa
nodes.notes: 9th Sapa Inca Pachacuti ('Earth-Shaker') transforms Cusco into the vast Tawantinsuyu empire and builds Machu Picchu; his son Tupac Inca Yupanqui even records a legendary Pacific balsa-raft voyage westward, followed by Huayna Capac -> Huáscar & Atahualpa!

nodes.name: Sky Woman (Atahensic) → Twin Brothers → Hiawatha & The Great Peacemaker
nodes.role: Turtle Island Origin & Five Nations Confederacy
nodes.notes: Sky Woman falls from Sky World onto the back of Great Turtle (Turtle Island), birthing the cosmic twins (Sapling & Flint); centuries later The Great Peacemaker (Deganawida), Jigonsaseh, and Hiawatha unite the Five Nations Confederacy!

nodes.name: First Man & First Woman / Changing Woman (Diné) & White Buffalo Calf Woman (Lakota)
nodes.notes: Diné tradition traces humanity through Four Worlds with First Man, First Woman, and Changing Woman (mother of Hero Twins Monster Slayer & Born for Water); Lakota tradition centers on White Buffalo Calf Woman uniting the Seven Council Fires (Oceti Sakowin).

nodes.name: Te Kore / Te Pō → Ranginui (Sky Father) & Papatūānuku (Earth Mother)
nodes.notes: Ranginui (Sky) and Papatūānuku (Earth) hold each other in darkness until their son Tāne-mahuta pushes them apart to let light into the world — striking universal parallel to Greek Gaia/Uranus, Vedic Dyaus/Prithvi, and Chinese Pangu!

nodes.name: Tāne-mahuta (+ Hine-ahu-one from Clay!), Tangaroa & Tūmatauenga
nodes.role: Creator of First Mortal Woman from Clay & Ocean God
nodes.notes: Tāne-mahuta shapes the first mortal woman Hine-ahu-one from red clay at Kurawaka and breathes life into her nostrils (tihei mauri ora!), while Tangaroa (Tagaloa) rules the Pacific Ocean and Tūmatauenga represents humanity!

nodes.name: Māui (Māui-tikitiki-a-Taranga — Pan-Polynesian Hero)
nodes.role: Fisher of Islands, Snarer of the Sun & Fire-Bringer
sources: Māori, Hawaiian, Tahitian, Samoan & Tongan Oral Epics
nodes.notes: Shared across every corner of the Polynesian Triangle (Hawaii to Aotearoa/New Zealand to Rapa Nui): fishes up islands from the sea, slows the Sun, and brings fire from Mahuika — uniting Polynesia's oral genealogies!

nodes.name: Wākea & Papahānaumoku → Hoʻohōkūkalani → Hāloa → King Kamehameha I
nodes.role: Ancestral Lineage of All Native Hawaiians & Hawaiian Monarchy
nodes.notes: The sacred Kumulipo traces cosmic evolution from coral polyp through Sky Father Wākea & Earth Mother Papa to Hāloa (first taro plant & first human ancestor of the Hawaiian people!), continuing down through Pāʻao and Umi-a-Līloa to King Kamehameha I (unifier of Hawaii, 1810)!

nodes.name: Hawaiki → Kupe (Aotearoa), ʻAhoʻeitu (Tuʻi Tonga) & Hotu Matuʻa (Rapa Nui)
nodes.role: Master Navigators of Aotearoa, Tonga & Easter Island
nodes.notes: Documents the greatest open-ocean ancestral voyaging in human history: Kupe & the Great Fleet waka settling Aotearoa (New Zealand), ʻAhoʻeitu founding the Tuʻi Tonga Empire (c. 950 CE, son of sky god Tangaloa!), and Ariki Hotu Matuʻa settling Rapa Nui (Easter Island)!
